overview.name: Innovator International Developed Power Buffer ETF - December
overview.description: The fund invests under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in investments that provide exposure to the iShares MSCI EAFE ETF. FLEX Options are exchange-traded option contracts with uniquely customizable terms. The fund is non-diversified.
